key.name: remove-preselected-box
key.description: When enabled, the extension clears GNOME Screenshot's initial pre-selected region and starts with an empty selection.

key.name: screenshot-on-release
key.summary: Automatically capture area selection on mouse release
key.description: When enabled, the extension triggers the screenshot capture as soon as the selection drag ends.

key.name: mute-screenshot-sound
key.description: When enabled, the extension suppresses the screen-capture sound event without changing other system or application audio.
